· [?] · the switch is in the register
shhh config · the checkout's file      [?] keys · [esc] back
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  …
  ❯ permission mode    ⏵⏵ auto — edits apply; allowli…  user
  ↓ 13 more

[↑↓/jk] move between settings
[enter] open the setting under the pointer, and take what is
in it
[/] filter the settings by name
[backspace] delete a character from the filter or the field
being typed into
[ctrl+r] reset this setting to its default
[ctrl+s] write every staged change to the checkout's
.shhh/config.toml
[shift+tab] switch the write between the checkout's file and
yours
[esc] clear the filter, then close it; leave the picker, or
leave the screen writing nothing
[esc] leave the screen writing nothing

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
[?] hide the keys
